svg.text: Architecture-first view before the protocol walkthrough: liquidity, KANGA emissions, xKANGA staking, fee conversion, launch migration, and controls.
Primary taxonomy: Distributed Platforms. AI Engineering is not claimed from the reviewed source material.

text.tspan: Use this slide to establish architecture and maturity boundaries.
Then use the protocol walkthrough slide for file-level implementation details.

text.tspan: Read left to right: liquidity plane first, incentive and staking plane second, migration/deployment/control plane third.
The next slide maps each box to concrete contracts, deploy scripts, tests, runtime steps, and implementation caveats.

g.text: AMM contracts provide familiar liquidity and swap primitives.
Reward and staking contracts create the tokenomics flywheel.
Migration and deployment are temporary, high-authority operating surfaces.
Boundaries stay visible without dominating the walkthrough slide.
